guarantees.claim: clr_all_keys is asserted when wipe_key_i is high OR clr_key_i is not one of the defined sideload clear targets (SideLoadClrIdle, SideLoadClrAes, SideLoadClrKmac, SideLoadClrOtbn).
slot_clr[AesIdx] is asserted when clr_all_keys is high OR clr_key_i equals SideLoadClrAes.
slot_clr[KmacIdx] is asserted when clr_all_keys is high OR clr_key_i equals SideLoadClrKmac.
slot_clr[OtbnIdx] is asserted when clr_all_keys is high OR clr_key_i equals SideLoadClrOtbn.
clr is asserted when any bit of slot_clr is high (OR reduction).

assumptions.claim: Parameters AesIdx, KmacIdx, OtbnIdx must be distinct and each less than LastIdx to avoid multiple drivers or out-of-bound indexing on slot_clr.
assumptions.risk: Multiple drivers on same bit or out-of-bound assignment can cause X propagation or functional failure in key clearing logic.

uncertain_points.claim: When clr_key_i is not a recognized sideload clear target (outside {SideLoadClrIdle, SideLoadClrAes, SideLoadClrKmac, SideLoadClrOtbn}), clr_all_keys is asserted, clearing all keys. It is unclear if this is an intentional fail-safe erasure or an unintended fault that could deny service.
uncertain_points.cond: if clr_key_i takes an invalid value (attacker inﬂuence, glitch, or software error)
uncertain_points.risk: Unintended clearing of all keys could impact system availability, cause denial of service, or disclose erasure behavior.

uncertain_points.claim: The mapping of AesIdx, KmacIdx, OtbnIdx to actual sideload key instances is determined at a higher integration level. Incorrect mapping could cause clearing of wrong keys or leaving sensitive keys uncleared.
uncertain_points.risk: Security-critical key clearing may be misdirected, compromising confidentiality or availability.
